title: Hiveeyes Nectar Flow Weight Gain Rate
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hiveeyes:reading
streamstats window=24 delta(weight_kg) as gain_kg
where gain_kg>1
description: Detects Hiveeyes hive weight surges indicating nectar flow.
value: Surfacing hiveeyes nectar flow weight gain rate helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant homestead, bees & livestock export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps when hiveeyes nectar flow weight gain rate matters for your routine.
